senses.gloss:
एष् एष् (cf. 1, 2. इष्), i. 1, Ātm. (after अनु and परि in epic poetry also Par.).
 1. To go.
 2. To strive to attain, Bhāg. P. 3, 13, 44.
 3. To search, Bhāg. P. 9, 4, 52.
 --With the prep अनु अनु, To search, MBh. 1, 5253; to investigate. Rām. 1, 3, 2.
 --With परि परि, To search, MBh. 13, 4033 (Par.)
